	switch(select("~ อุปกรณ์ตีอาวุธ" , "~ อุปกรณ์ปรุงยา" , "~ อุปกรณ์สัตว์เลี้ยง")) {
		
		case 1:	sleep2 100;	callshop "T1S",1;	break;
		case 2:	sleep2 100;	callshop "T2S",1;	break;
		case 3:	sleep2 100;	callshop "T4S",1;	break;
		case 4:	sleep2 100;	callshop "T3S",1;	break;

	}
}
